## Summary

<!-- What does this pull request change, and why? -->

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Refactoring (no behaviour change)
- [ ] Build / packaging / CI
- [ ] Tests only

## Related issues

<!-- Link any related issues, for example: Closes #12 -->

## Checklist

- [ ] I ran `python -m ruff check .` and it passes.
- [ ] I ran `python -m pytest -q` and it passes.
- [ ] I added or updated tests for this change.
- [ ] I did **not** add a GUI dependency to `app/core`, `app/network`,
      `app/optimization` or `app/reporting`.
- [ ] I did **not** disable or weaken any security feature (Firewall, Defender,
      IPv6, input validation, report redaction).
- [ ] I documented any user-visible change.
- [ ] I updated the documentation (`README.md` and/or `docs/`) where needed.
